comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: What strikes me most about North Korea is that behind all the political headlines, there are ordinary people raising children, working, and trying to build meaningful lives. I wish the world could learn more about their everyday experiences, not just what we see in the news.

comments.author: @Epiclandwow
comments.text: Đợt này không thấy bơm nữa nhỉ?
